stem: Which sentence best supports the idea that Brody has a change of attitude about nature?

options.label: A
options.text: When they reached the top of the mountain, Brody's one reward was a glimpse of an eagle circling in the skies. (paragraph 14)

options.label: B
options.text: "Can't leave you behind," Uncle Stephen told him, and Brody nodded his head, seeing no way out. (paragraph 19)

options.label: C
options.text: "Don't you ever get bored?" Brody finally blurted out. (paragraph 22)

options.label: D
options.text: He had to swat away another bug, but he no longer felt annoyed. (paragraph 26)
